description: Time to get down to business with this executive desk from the Barrister Lane® collection. Its spacious tabletop surface provides you with room for all your must have office essentials – laptop, notebooks, décor, and of course your favorite coffee mug. This handsome desk features two storage drawers that open and close on smooth metal runners. It also includes a lower file drawer with full extension slides to accommodate letter-size hanging files so you can keep organized and clutter free! Behind the door is a hidden storage area that includes an adjustable shelf for all your additional storage needs. It also features open cubbyhole storage with an adjustable shelf for all your easy access office items. Finished on all sides in a stunning Iron Oak and accented with gold hardware, this good looking desk will have you motivated and feeling like a top executive.
